tldr: 台股週一跌 1% 收 44,762 點，失守 45,000 與季線，外資賣超約 157.5 億元、連 4 賣台積電。
AI 需求續旺，台積電 CoWoS 產能 2027 年前將倍增，半導體設備出口年增 44.75%。
金管會政策動作頻頻，修正金控與銀行財報準則、引導保險資金投入公共建設，並研擬「資產管理專法」推動亞資中心。
稅務面，財政部強化房地合一反避稅規定，立院修正遺贈稅與所得稅，牽動高資產傳承與家庭稅務規劃。
海外方面，晶片股賣壓拖累那斯達克，油價因美國對伊朗新制裁下跌，金價創三個月高點，市場聚焦輝達財報與 Jackson Hole 年會。

items.title_zh: 台股週一跌 1%、失守 45,000 與季線，外資轉為賣方
items.title_en: TAIEX slides 1% on Monday, losing 45,000 and its quarterly line as foreign investors turn sellers
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週一（8/24）開高走低，終場跌 461.97 點、跌幅 1.02%，收 44,762.32 點，同時跌破 45,000 關卡與季線，單日成交量約 6,519 億元。三大法人合計賣超約 163.77 億元，其中外資賣超約 157.51 億元，為近期最大單日賣壓。市場在輝達財報與聯準會 Jackson Hole 年會前趨於保守，資金觀望氣氛升溫，盤面權值與傳產同步承壓。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark opened higher but reversed to close down 461.97 points, or 1.02%, at 44,762.32 on Monday (Aug 24), slipping below both the 45,000 mark and its quarterly moving average. Turnover was about NT$651.9 billion. The three major institutional investors were net sellers of roughly NT$163.8 billion, led by foreign investors offloading about NT$157.5 billion — the heaviest single-day selling in recent sessions — as caution built ahead of a data- and event-heavy week.

items.title_zh: 投信終結連 23 買超、外資連 4 賣台積電
items.title_en: Investment trusts end 23-day buying streak as foreign funds dump TSMC for a fourth session
items.summary_zh: 盤面資金結構轉弱，投信終結連 23 個交易日買超，外資則連續第 4 個交易日賣超台積電。外資單日買超最多為 DRAM 廠力積電、加碼約 3.8 萬張，同時大砍台塑四寶。外資期貨空單略增至約 8.25 萬口，顯示對後市轉趨保守。法人資金在權值股與傳產族群間輪動、短線觀望，靜待輝達財報與央行年會等關鍵事件提供方向指引。
items.summary_en: Beneath the headline drop, domestic investment trusts snapped a 23-session net-buying run, while foreign investors sold Taiwan Semiconductor for a fourth straight day. Foreigners' biggest purchase was DRAM maker Powerchip, adding about 38,000 lots, even as they hit the Formosa Plastics group hard. Foreign net short positions in index futures edged up to around 82,500 contracts, underscoring a cautious near-term stance.

items.title_zh: 台積電 CoWoS 先進封裝產能將倍增、AI 需求續強
items.title_en: TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity set to more than double as AI demand runs hot
items.summary_zh: 法人估台積電 CoWoS 先進封裝月產能今、明年底將分別達約 7～7.5 萬片、10～10.5 萬片，對應年產能約 63.6 萬、106.2 萬片，年增幅分別約 104%、67%。此積極擴產反映 AI 加速器客戶需求仍旺，先進封裝續為台積電與台廠半導體供應鏈的結構性主流題材，並帶動 CoWoS、散熱、ABF 載板等相關次族群的中長期成長動能。
items.summary_en: TSMC's monthly CoWoS capacity is projected to reach roughly 70,000-75,000 wafers by end-2026 and 100,000-105,000 by end-2027, implying annual output of about 636,000 and 1.06 million wafers — year-on-year growth of around 104% and 67%. The aggressive build-out reflects still-surging demand from AI accelerator customers, keeping advanced packaging the structural leadership theme for TSMC and Taiwan's broader semiconductor supply chain.

items.title_zh: 半導體設備領軍、台灣機械出口受 AI 擴產浪潮帶動大增
items.title_en: Taiwan's machinery and equipment exports surge on the AI capacity-expansion wave
items.summary_zh: 台灣機械產業乘 AI 建置浪潮，半導體與平面顯示器設備出口額達約 28.57 億美元、年增 44.75%，主因全球 AI 算力需求爆發與半導體擴產持續。整體機械出口年增 18.51%，由半導體設備與 AI 相關機器人領軍。數據顯示 AI 供應鏈受惠面正由晶片業者向上游設備、自動化與零組件供應商擴散，帶動台廠中上游族群同步受惠、出口動能延續。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's machinery exports are riding the AI build-out: semiconductor and flat-panel-display equipment shipments reached about US$2.857 billion, up 44.75% year on year, as global compute demand and chip-capacity expansion accelerate. Overall machinery exports rose 18.51%, led by semiconductor tooling and AI-related robotics. The data underscore how the AI supply chain is broadening beyond chipmakers into upstream equipment and automation suppliers.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正金控與銀行財報編製準則
items.title_en: FSC amends financial-report preparation standards for financial holdings and banks
items.summary_zh: 金管會 8 月 18 日修正「金融控股公司財務報告編製準則」與「公開發行銀行財務報告編製準則」，以提升資訊揭露透明度與可比較性。相關調整為金融業接軌新一代會計與清償能力制度鋪路，促使機構提升資產負債表揭露品質。此舉為後續多項新制上路預作準備，牽動金融業整體體質與監理節奏，也讓投資人更易比較各金控與行庫的財務狀況與經營成果。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission amended on Aug 18 the preparation standards for the financial reports of financial holding companies and publicly issued banks, aiming to lift disclosure transparency and comparability. The revisions form part of the groundwork as the sector converges toward next-generation accounting and solvency frameworks, nudging institutions toward cleaner, more consistent balance-sheet reporting ahead of a broader run of new rules taking effect.

items.title_zh: 金管會引導保險資金挹注公共建設
items.title_en: Regulators move to channel insurance capital into Taiwan's public infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 金管會 8 月 20 日發布新聞稿指出，正跨部會擴大公共建設可投資標的範圍，導引壽險業長期資金活水挹注國內基礎建設。此舉在提供壽險業穩定、長天期的投資去化管道，同時支持國家重大建設，兼顧保險業資產負債配置與公共政策目標。隨壽險業接軌 IFRS 17 與新清償制度，長期公建投資可望成為業者調整資產配置的重要方向。
items.summary_en: In an Aug 20 statement, the FSC said it is working across agencies to widen the pool of eligible public-construction projects so insurers' long-term capital can be directed into domestic infrastructure. The initiative aims to give life insurers stable, long-duration investment targets while supporting national building programmes — a policy that could reshape insurers' asset allocation as they adapt to IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime.

items.title_zh: 8 月台股 ETF 配息潮起、資金轉進息收商品
items.title_en: August brings a wave of Taiwan ETF payouts as investors chase income amid volatility
items.summary_zh: 本月超過 60 檔台股 ETF 公告配息，在關稅、財政與地緣情勢牽動、大盤震盪加劇之際，吸引投資人轉向穩定領息標的。高股息產品領先，00881 以年化殖利率近 9% 居配息排行之冠。此波配息潮反映散戶與財管客戶在盤勢震盪下，將資金轉進高股息 ETF 作為偏防禦、重現金流的資產配置選擇，也帶動相關 ETF 規模與受益人數持續成長。
items.summary_en: More than 60 Taiwan-listed equity ETFs have declared distributions this month, drawing investors toward steady income as the market swings sharply on tariff, fiscal and geopolitical headlines. High-yield products lead the pack, with 00881 topping the rankings at an annualised yield near 9%. The rush reflects a broader rotation by retail and wealth clients into dividend ETFs as a defensive, cash-flow-oriented allocation during choppy conditions.

items.title_zh: 金管會推亞洲資產管理中心、研擬「資產管理專法」
items.title_en: FSC advances Asia Asset Management Center with a draft Asset Management Act
items.summary_zh: 金管會打造台灣為亞洲資產管理中心的政策已邁入關鍵階段，正研議專屬的「資產管理專法」，並於 7 月底公布草案架構，推動亞資中心由試辦創新走向制度化。此舉旨在深化本地在基金管理、私募市場與跨境服務的能量，回應高資產客戶與家族辦公室對整合式財富管理與另類投資的需求，強化台灣財管生態的國際競爭力與資金留存動能。
items.summary_en: The FSC's push to build Taiwan into an Asia asset-management hub has entered a decisive phase, with regulators drafting a dedicated Asset Management Act and publishing the framework of the draft in late July. The move aims to shift the initiative from pilot-stage innovation toward an institutionalised regime, deepening onshore capabilities in fund management, private markets and cross-border services for high-net-worth and family-office clients.

items.title_zh: 財政部修正房地合一稅、強化防杜避稅
items.title_en: MOF tightens anti-avoidance rules in the house-and-land transaction income tax
items.summary_zh: 財政部 8 月 21 日修正「房地合一課徵所得稅申報作業要點」，就股權價值認定等反避稅規定加以調整，並自即日生效。此次修正針對以移轉不動產占比高的股權方式規避房地合一課稅的漏洞加以防堵，收緊個人與營利事業間接移轉不動產的稅務認定，牽動高資產族群與企業的不動產交易與稅務規劃布局，未來以股權形式處分不動產須更審慎評估稅負。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance amended on Aug 21 the filing guidelines for the consolidated house-and-land income tax, refining anti-avoidance provisions on how the value of property-heavy equity is recognised, effective the same day. The change targets loopholes where real estate is transferred via share deals to sidestep the property-gains regime, tightening the net around indirect property transactions for both individuals and corporate sellers.

items.title_zh: 立院修正遺贈稅與所得稅、牽動傳承與家庭稅務規劃
items.title_en: Legislature's estate-, gift- and income-tax overhaul reshapes succession planning
items.summary_zh: 立法院 8 月 21 日三讀修正《遺產及贈與稅法》死前 2 年贈與課稅規定，改由受贈人按比例、以所受財產價值為限為納稅義務人，並取消遺產稅分期繳納門檻；同步修正《所得稅法》減輕育兒家庭稅負。相關修法對高資產家庭的傳承布局與一般家庭的綜所稅規劃均有實質影響，牽動財富傳承與節稅策略，也讓贈與時點與資產移轉方式的規劃更趨重要。
items.summary_en: Amendments passed on Aug 21 revised the Estate & Gift Tax Act's deathbed-gift rules — making beneficiaries proportional taxpayers capped at what they received and removing the threshold for paying estate tax in instalments — while changes to the Income Tax Act eased the burden on families raising children. Together the measures materially affect high-net-worth succession and household tax planning.

items.title_zh: AI 需求續旺、台灣出口連逾 32 個月正成長
items.title_en: Taiwan's exports stay red-hot as AI demand powers another monthly gain
items.summary_zh: 7 月出口約 753 億美元，為歷年單月第 3 高、年增約 32.9%，出口連續正成長已逾 32 個月；累計 1～7 月出口年增約 44.7%。受 AI、高效能運算與雲端服務熱潮帶動，資通與視聽產品、電子零組件維持高檔成長，兩者合計占總出口比重約 78.7%。強勁外需為台灣經濟提供支撐，但也使成長高度集中於科技供應鏈，須留意高基期後的動能變化與匯率影響。
items.summary_en: July exports reached about US$75.3 billion, the third-highest monthly total on record and up roughly 32.9% year on year, extending the run of consecutive monthly increases beyond 32 months. Cumulative January-July exports rose about 44.7% from a year earlier. Information-and-communications and electronic-component products — buoyed by AI, high-performance computing and cloud demand — now make up around 78.7% of total shipments.

items.title_zh: AI 榮景推升成長預測、學者估動能將再平衡
items.title_en: Forecasts upgraded on the AI boom, but economists see momentum rebalancing
items.summary_zh: AI 供應鏈出口強勁帶動官方上修台灣成長預測，也再度引發央行是否收緊政策的討論。惟經濟學者預期，成長動能將由過度倚賴單一外需引擎，逐步轉向由出口、投資與消費共同支撐的均衡模式；隨內需回溫、2025 年高基期壓抑，整體成長率估收斂。政策焦點落在利率路徑與新台幣匯率，牽動資金環境與產業投資布局。
items.summary_en: Strong AI-supply-chain exports have prompted upward revisions to Taiwan's growth outlook, reviving debate over whether the central bank could tighten. Yet economists expect the expansion to rebalance over time from an over-reliance on a single external engine toward one supported jointly by exports, investment and consumption, as domestic demand warms and a high 2025 base caps headline growth — keeping the rate path and the NT dollar in focus.

items.title_zh: 台媒示警美股本週三大關卡：輝達、華許、PCE
items.title_en: Taiwan media flag a three-hurdle week for US stocks: Nvidia, Warsh and PCE
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體聚焦本週華爾街三大考驗：輝達美股週三盤後財報、聯準會主席華許週五 Jackson Hole 首場主題演說，以及 7 月 PCE 物價數據。市場預期輝達繳出另一季 AI 帶動的強勁成長，營收市場預估約 920 億美元，其財測被視為 AI 交易與台灣科技供應鏈的風向球，牽動台股權值與 AI 族群後續評價與資金動能。
items.summary_en: Local financial outlets are framing the week around three key tests for Wall Street: Nvidia's earnings after Wednesday's US close, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, and the July PCE inflation print. Markets expect Nvidia to post another quarter of strong AI-driven growth, with consensus revenue around US$92 billion, making its guidance a bellwether for the AI trade and Taiwan's tech supply chain.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報牽動 AI 投資、Fed 主席將赴 Jackson Hole 發聲
items.title_en: Nvidia's results to sway AI investment as the Fed chair heads to Jackson Hole
items.summary_zh: 報導指出，輝達已被市場視為整個 AI 生態系的代表而非單純半導體公司，其業績可反映晶片、資料中心及相關融資需求是否依舊強勁。報導並聚焦華許在 Jackson Hole 的演說，投資人關注其對通膨、就業市場與貨幣政策走向的看法；因近期美國數據分歧，談話訊號恐牽動全球風險偏好與資金流向。
items.summary_en: Coverage highlights how Nvidia — now viewed as a proxy for the entire AI ecosystem rather than just a chipmaker — will show whether demand for chips, data centres and related financing remains robust. Reports also spotlight Warsh's Jackson Hole address, with investors watching for cues on inflation, the labour market and the policy path amid mixed US data.

items.title_zh: 美股週一漲跌互見、晶片股賣壓拖累那斯達克（2026-08-24）
items.title_en: US stocks close mixed on Monday as a chip-stock sell-off drags the Nasdaq (2026-08-24)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街本週開盤表現分歧：標普 500 跌 0.3% 收 7,652.86 點，那斯達克因半導體賣壓跌 0.8% 收 25,980.19 點，道瓊則漲 0.3% 收 53,417.16 點。美光重挫約 5.8%，超微、博通分別跌逾 3%、2%；輝達在週三財報前跌 2.9%。美國對伊朗祭出新制裁亦增添市場保守氣氛。
items.summary_en: Wall Street was mixed to start the week: the S&P 500 slipped 0.3% to 7,652.86 and the Nasdaq fell 0.8% to 25,980.19 as semiconductors sold off, while the Dow rose 0.3% to 53,417.16. Micron dropped about 5.8%, with AMD and Broadcom down more than 3% and 2%; Nvidia fell 2.9% ahead of its Wednesday earnings. New US sanctions on Iran added to the cautious tone.

items.title_zh: 美國對伊朗發動「經濟放逐行動」、油價下跌（2026-08-24）
items.title_en: Oil falls as the US launches 'Operation Economic Outcast' against Iran (2026-08-24)
items.summary_zh: 原油週一走跌，布蘭特原油跌約 2.5% 至每桶約 92 美元，因美國財政部長貝森特正式啟動「Operation Economic Outcast（經濟放逐行動）」，以大規模次級制裁切斷伊朗經濟命脈。首波鎖定近 60 個個人、實體與船隻，華府並表明中國不會豁免。地緣政治風險續為能源市場焦點，市場觀望制裁後續對供給面的影響。
items.summary_en: Crude slid on Monday, with Brent down about 2.5% to roughly $92 a barrel, after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent formally launched "Operation Economic Outcast," a sweeping campaign of secondary sanctions aimed at severing Iran's economic lifelines. The first round targeted nearly 60 individuals, entities and vessels, and Washington signalled China would not be exempt, keeping geopolitical risk front of mind for energy markets.

items.title_zh: 金價攻抵三個月高點、殖利率與美元走弱（2026-08-24）
items.title_en: Gold hits a three-month high as yields and the dollar slide before PCE and Jackson Hole (2026-08-24)
items.summary_zh: 黃金週一升至每盎司約 4,630 美元、創 5 月中以來新高，因美國財政部意外將長天期公債回購規模加倍，壓低債券殖利率與美元，重新點燃「貨幣貶值交易」。在投資人等待週三 7 月 PCE 通膨數據與週五華許 Jackson Hole 演說之際，黃金作為另類價值儲存的吸引力增強，避險與抗通膨買盤同步進場。
items.summary_en: Gold climbed to around $4,630 an ounce on Monday, its highest since mid-May, after the US Treasury unexpectedly doubled its long-dated bond-buyback programme, pushing yields and the dollar lower and reviving the "debasement trade." Bullion's appeal as an alternative store of value strengthened as investors awaited Wednesday's July PCE inflation data and Warsh's Friday Jackson Hole speech.

items.title_zh: 市場屏息迎 Jackson Hole、押注偏向 Fed 短期不降息（2026-08-24）
items.title_en: Markets brace for Jackson Hole as bets tilt away from near-term Fed cuts (2026-08-24)
items.summary_zh: 投資人為聯準會 8/27～29 的 Jackson Hole 年會布局，主席華許將以「金融創新」為題發表上任後首場主題演說。在美國數據分歧下，市場已收斂對近期降息的預期，甚至對今年升息給予一定機率，分析師預期談話將維持「數據依賴」基調。即使前瞻指引有限，任何政策訊號仍可能牽動利率、美元與全球股市走向。
items.summary_en: Investors are positioning for the Fed's Aug 27-29 Jackson Hole symposium, where Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first keynote on the theme "Financial Innovation." With US data mixed, markets have pared expectations for imminent easing — pricing meaningful odds of a hike rather than a cut this year — and analysts expect a data-dependent message. Even a scarce forward-guidance signal could still move rates, the dollar and global equities.
